newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 30.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Government advisory panel calls for creation of watchdog organisation for public corporations.
-- Sony Corp, Sharp Corp and Philips Electronics NV to jointly develop next-generation liquid crystal displays (LCDs).
-- Nippon Credit Bank Ltd to promote Vice President Shigeoki Togo to presidency.
-- Finance Ministry to decide today penalty on Nomura Securities Co Ltd and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd for involvement in corporate racketeer scandal.
-- Murder suspect caught after 15 years, just 21 days before statute of limitations runs out.
-- Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd also linked to corporate racketeer in stock loss compensation deals.
-- Finance Ministry to suspend Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd's (DKB) lending to new customers by the end of this year.
-- Finance Ministry officials reprimanded for being entertained by Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank.
